dataset_or_cohort_summary: GHSI developer online panel / overlapping report-preprint programme
counting_note: Two defining publications from one overlapping development programme.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: Original Canadian development survey and subsamples
counting_note: Defining/development programme; not a subsequent primary count.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: Canadian population datasets plus LLLP; publications overlap; one journal full text blocked
counting_note: Count once as a subsequent primary programme. Blocked 2013 paper contributes no extracted findings.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: British Gambling Prevalence Survey 2007
counting_note: Dataset later appears within a separate pooled multi-survey analysis; dataset independence is not implied.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: 13 UK surveys 2007–2023 including BGPS 2007
counting_note: Separate analytic programme; overlaps one earlier dataset.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: 2020–21 Treatment and Support Survey plus cognitive interviews
counting_note: Corporate authorship prevents clean author-independence classification.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: Eight England surveys; probability/quota/mode/filter comparisons
counting_note: Methodological programme on prevalence comparability rather than a new scale-development study.

programme_label: Original 12-item G-SAS validation in multicentre nalmefene trial
dataset_or_cohort_summary: 207 US adults with DSM-IV pathological gambling; 15 sites; placebo retest subgroup 44; treated longitudinal subgroup 125 (CGI analyses 124).
counting_note: One defining source/programme. Trial application within same programme is not subsequent validation.

programme_label: Singapore clinical 12-item factor-structure and construct-validity study
dataset_or_cohort_summary: 521 treatment-seeking adults from Singapore treatment outcome monitoring, April 2013–February 2015; 35 casino self-exclusion-revocation attendees excluded. EFA 255, CFA 266.
counting_note: One subsequent primary programme/publication. Count applies to named 12-item form; does not establish English-language replication or independent datasets.

programme_label: Japanese G-SAS MIC estimation using pooled internet-intervention trials
dataset_or_cohort_summary: 281 complete baseline/week-1 pairs: 101/138 GAMBOT2 (UMIN000046835) and 180/274 GAMCHECK (UMIN000040003); reused trial cohorts.
counting_note: One analytic programme pooling two existing RCT cohorts; retained as translated-form context, excluded from original-form completed primary count.

programme_label: Spanish adaptation and revised 11-item factor solution
dataset_or_cohort_summary: Spain online convenience sample, recent three-month gambling, July 2021–April 2022; analytic N=322 as Methods/Table 5, abstract reports 364.
counting_note: Revision/form-development context only; excluded from locked original-form defining and subsequent counts; no new canonical object created.

programme_label: PHQ-9 original development and clinical validation
dataset_or_cohort_summary: US primary-care cohort 3000 and obstetrics-gynaecology cohort 3000; diagnostic/reinterview subset 580.
counting_note: One defining publication/programme, containing two original cohorts; not two independent subsequent studies.

programme_label: PANDA UK primary-care patient-perceived change cohort
dataset_or_cohort_summary: 559 baseline participants; 400 complete observations at baseline and every two weeks over six weeks; UK primary care, mostly white and female, 88% taking antidepressants.
counting_note: One original-form longitudinal methodological programme/publication. Patient-perceived improvement threshold is not universal individual reliable change.

programme_label: Barcelona PHQ-9 repeat administration and telephone-mode programme
dataset_or_cohort_summary: 346 participants: 289 primary-care patients and 57 staff; self/telephone118, telephone/self113, telephone/telephone58, self/self57; within seven days.
counting_note: Count for specified nine-item operational form; administration language unresolved, not an English-language replication claim. Staff-only self/self subgroup differs from clinical groups.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: 167 follow-up respondents from German validation cohort of 528; baseline major depression55, other depression53, none59; mean follow-up12.3 months.
counting_note: Translated-form context; excluded from original-form completed primary count. Reuses baseline validation cohort; changes in administration mode/reference interview may affect change.

programme_label: German Deprexis slot-machine-gambler trial: incidental PHQ-9 consistency
dataset_or_cohort_summary: 145 allocated to depression-intervention comparison;140 ITT after exclusions, 62 completed eight-week follow-up; part of original four-arm programme.
counting_note: German-form incidental consistency evidence retained separately from application. Correction and article share programme. Excluded from original-language primary counts; not gambling diagnostic validation.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: 44 healthy controls; EVR plus six comparable ventromedial-prefrontal patients (Figure2 N7); nine other brain-lesion controls; small repeat-assessment subset.
counting_note: One original development publication/programme; not a gambling-disorder validation programme.

programme_label: Temple IGT repeat-assessment and generative modelling programme
dataset_or_cohort_summary: 50 US undergraduates at baseline, 46 retested about one month later; age18–24. Joint model includes incomplete records.
counting_note: One programme; raw choice score and multiple model parameters do not create multiple programmes. Original-payoff implementation is explicitly identified, not physical/computer equivalence.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: 40 undergraduates, 20 original-question and 20 structured-question conditions.
counting_note: One primary methodological programme about original-task interpretation; probe modification explicitly retained. Count does not imply psychometric validation of bare canonical administration.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: 72 healthy Soochow students,35 men37 women, three successive 100-choice runs separated by minutes.
counting_note: Clinical-version contextual evidence; excluded from original-payoff anchor primary count.

programme_label: US clinical IGT three-week test–retest programme
dataset_or_cohort_summary: 173 initial participants,120 returned,98 met multi-task completion criterion; IGT paired N94 (t93), about21.87 days apart.
counting_note: Clinical-version context; not original physical/fixed-payoff score validation. No cohort independence claimed from authorship alone.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: 30 DSM-IV pathological gamblers and35 controls in Brussels. Primary Table1: PG27 men3 women, controls29 men6 women; source population/control reuse with other Brevers studies unclear.
counting_note: Incidental variant development/application, not a completed anchor methodological programme; earlier Persaud method already acknowledged in locked register.

programme_label: DSM-5 framework development/rationale and authoritative criterion reproduction
dataset_or_cohort_summary: Committee/literature-review framework development; official 2013 documents and2016 reproduction of same2013 criteria. Not four empirical validation programmes.
counting_note: Four accessible defining/specification references share one framework-development context. Rationale is also a secondary narrative source; roles do not create extra primary programmes. Blocked original manual excluded.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: NESARC2001–2002 N43093; shared AUDADIS-IV answers recoded. Reused survey cohort, not newly recruited independent validation dataset.
counting_note: One publication, one criteria-method programme; edition concordance rather than independent diagnostic accuracy.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: N3247 across eight pre-existing Canadian/US/Spanish clinical/community datasets; one-week ICC in Minnesota datasets 135/175.
counting_note: One publication/programme, not eight programmes. Original wording/clinical-status proxy qualifications essential.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: ESA2009 and2009 slot-machine study; analysis Ns107/376 after restriction to one–eight criteria. Existing cohorts.
counting_note: One publication/programme with two samples; no confirmed full-APA-team author independence.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: 574 pooled baseline participants from clinical/neuroimaging/treatment studies2001–2016; overlap with other Minnesota programmes possible, not established.
counting_note: One programme; cross-sectional associations cannot establish change/responsiveness or treatment response.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: 4203 Bellvitge treatment seekers2005–March2023; possible overlap with earlier Spanish clinical cohorts in Stinchfield programme; no participant linkage.
counting_note: Distinct methodological programme, not independent dataset. Methods explicitly DSM-5 recoding; no DSM-5-TR count.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: 11 North-American academic sites, selected adult/child diagnoses; no gambling diagnosis estimate reported in expanded adult results.
counting_note: Framework development context only; not a completed subsequent gambling-criteria programme or evidence for all diagnoses.

programme_label: Memphis past-year DIGS interview measurement and screening-comparison programme
dataset_or_cohort_summary: 159 US undergraduates; SOGS oversampling. This cohort also underlies Weinstock/Whelan/Meyers 2008 behavioural-assessment publication, which is not separately retained/count-added.
counting_note: One programme/publication with direct interview alpha and convergence. Past-year administration; does not establish original lifetime reliability, inter-rater agreement or independent diagnostic accuracy.

programme_label: South African DIGS interview measurement within PGSI validation
dataset_or_cohort_summary: 127 self-selected English-proficient Cape Town/Durban community gamblers; excluded substance abuse/dependence.
counting_note: One programme: direct DIGS consistency and convergence beyond mere use. Alpha item-count discrepancy retained and limits interpretation; primary target is PGSI. Current/lifetime implementation, no independent clinical DIGS accuracy.

programme_label: Georgia participant-rated DIGS DSM-IV criterion structure programme
dataset_or_cohort_summary: 660 frequent-gambling undergraduates, University of Georgia. Potential recruitment-stream reuse with other Georgia research not resolved by participant linkage.
counting_note: Self-report implementation retained as modified-form context, excluded from original clinician-interview primary counts. Delivery medium not unequivocally specified for DIGS.

programme_label: Georgia DIGS-S self-report adaptation and repeat-assessment programme
dataset_or_cohort_summary: 72 completers over three sessions about four weeks apart; baseline table N81. Likely first-cohort overlap with Fortune/Goodie sensation-seeking application (same authors, N81 and baseline correlation .72); participant identity not confirmed.
counting_note: Development/measurement of DIGS-S, not directly retrieved development of the original DIGS interview; not added to original-object primary or defining counts.

programme_label: NICE NG248 guideline development, evidence review and implementation resources
dataset_or_cohort_summary: Guideline committee/evidence synthesis and unpopulated official implementation resources; no recruited evaluation cohort for the specified multi-domain clinical assessment.
counting_note: One guideline-development context, not four empirical programmes. Only the guideline is counted as defining specification; review and implementation documents have separate contextual/resource roles. Zero subsequent primary evaluations retained.

programme_label: WMH-CIDI development and initial NCS-R gambling-module specification
dataset_or_cohort_summary: Developer specification and methodological rationale; initial NCS-R materials precede later WMH releases.
counting_note: Two defining/specification references, one development context; not a validation cohort count.

programme_label: WMH-CIDI3.0 clinical reappraisal of psychiatric modules: NCS-R and ESEMeD
dataset_or_cohort_summary: US NCS-R main clinical-reappraisal n325; European12-month within60-day analysis n143. Underlying US survey overlaps NCS-R gambling2008; psychiatric modules differ and PG not evaluated.
counting_note: One coordinated reappraisal programme, not one per country/disorder/table. Eligible broad WMH anchor programme; explicitly non-gambling. No author or dataset independence claim.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: Weighted gambling sub-sample3435 from NCS-R household survey9282; alpha analysis denominator not separately stated. Shared parent cohort with Haro US reappraisal, not independently recruited dataset.
counting_note: One module-specific measurement programme for reported consistency; application results remain separate. Not a clinical diagnostic validation programme.

programme_label: PAGE German gambling-module modification and gate-sensitivity fieldwork
dataset_or_cohort_summary: German general-population telephone sample15023 ages14–64; first1007 interim gate analysis; distinct PAGE cohort, with modified module.
counting_note: Methodological evidence retained for modified operationalisation only; no additional anchor primary/independent count. Authorship compared with Kessler/Ustun and named gambling developers Winters/Wallisch.

programme_label: Original CSO collateral DSM-IV screen / minimal-intervention pilot development
dataset_or_cohort_summary: Makarchuk2001 thesis pilot N31; originating2002 journal report likely describes this same pilot, but full journal text unavailable. No dataset independence inferred.
counting_note: One originating development context. Only accessible thesis contributes defining extraction; blocked journal retained for provenance, not an additional completed evidence programme.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: Study1:57 analysed college gamblers; Study2:58 separate college gamblers; two samples within one development publication/programme.
counting_note: One defining reference/programme; samples are not counted as subsequent primary programmes.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: Retest35 participants from relapse cohort; collateral components from relapse and self-help cohorts. Coordinated earlier adaptation paper, not a subsequent seven-dimension replication.
counting_note: Earlier adaptation; excluded from canonical2004 defining and subsequent counts. Author-independent from2004 team does not change chronology/form boundary.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: 133 gambler–CSO dyads from pooled Swedish internet-CBT pilot/RCT recruitment2015–2017; one baseline programme, not two independent cohorts counted separately.
counting_note: One author-independent programme for a modified two-output implementation; separately described and excluded from complete seven-dimension anchor count.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: 2023 update reuses2018HSE gambling prevalence, pooled surveys for stratification and international/English harm-risk inputs from previous2021 costing. No participant validation cohort.
counting_note: One retained defining publication/programme;2021predecessor discussed but not added/counting as a new programme.

programme_label: 2019 commissioned gambling-harms costing scope and companion guide
dataset_or_cohort_summary: Same Gambling Commission2019commissioned scoping/guidance programme. Expert interviews/survey support scoping; guide example is hypothetical, not a new empirical cohort.
counting_note: One overlapping programme with two publications; r8 defining-context reference and r9implementation resource. Only r8 enters defining-reference count; guide is not a primary validation or observed application.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: 5122working-age respondents from2017GamblingHarms survey of three Finnish regions;2016activities/registers.130past-problem-gambling respondents;14also long-term work disabled. Same survey/register data across all method arms and earlier survey outputs.
counting_note: One subsequent author-independent methodological programme; regional single-domain excess-cost operationalisation within the locked broad method. Does not validate all causal PAF orOHIDdomain algorithms. Shared survey data do not imply independent datasets.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: Conceptual exposition with clinical illustrations; no single validation cohort.
counting_note: One retained defining reference/programme grouping; not unique historical origin or empirical validation programme.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: German convenience online sample;879 initial respondents,75 non-serious and2 age-inconsistent exclusions; analysed paired Ns vary584–595. Same cohort in original and erratum.
counting_note: One primary programme and one primary study paper; erratum is correction only. No single generic VAS developer team for independence comparison.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: 446 German volunteers/rehabilitation participants;VAS231,Likert215 at baseline;129-item survey,55 agreement-format items. Distinct from2017 personality cohort; some author overlap is not dataset overlap.
counting_note: One primary programme/one paper. Format-specific missingness/burden evidence, not a universal VAS reliability or change validation.

programme_label: GAMTOMS2007 package development: questionnaire and interview cohorts
dataset_or_cohort_summary: Questionnaire:87 clinical/24 nonclinical; recruitedNov2000–Aug2001 at3Minnesota programmes. Interview:150clinical/25nonclinical;Jun2002–Jun2004 at2Minnesota programmes. Distinct cohorts within one linked package-development programme; shared agencies do not prove participant independence.
counting_note: One defining/development paper/programme containing two form cohorts; neither counted as a subsequent programme. Author team is package developers.

programme_label: Hanneman and Riddle2005 defining methodological exposition
dataset_or_cohort_summary: Conceptual textbook; no validation cohort.
counting_note: One defining exposition grouping, not a unique SNA development programme or origin claim.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: Erdos–Renyi random graphs; random node/edge addition/deletion. Computational experiment, no participant cohort.
counting_note: One simulation programme and one paper; no universal human-network error tolerance.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: Reanalysis of1985,1987,1988 US General Social Surveys and Northern California Community Study. Cohorts also occur in earlier network literature/review; not claimed dataset-independent. NCCS dates differ within report.
counting_note: One underlying programme; only the1992 full report retained/extracted. Different datasets and comparisons within this report are not separately counted.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: Formal causal models and newly generated toy-network simulations, including400-node networks regenerated5,000 times; no participant cohort.
counting_note: One computational methodological programme, one paper. Count justified by original simulation experiments; theorem is not separately counted. Not an observed gambling validation or proof that every network design lacks causal identification.

programme_label: Medeiros2018 source-specific loss operationalisation and clinical baseline comparison
dataset_or_cohort_summary: 436 US gambling-disorder trial participants pooled across multiple trials; comparator-specific missingness. Prior trial cohorts reused, not independent new datasets.
counting_note: One empirical operationalisation-development programme; not also counted as subsequent primary. Correlations with severity/disability are not monetary accuracy validation.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: Ontario2003 RDD survey6654 adults;2424 quantifiable expenditure respondents; prospective diary subset364. One programme, retrospective typical-month and subsequent diary windows differ.
counting_note: One primary question-format comparison programme. No individual operator-verified gold standard; aggregate revenue comparison is not person-level truth.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: 1335 respondents from17742 Norwegian Norsk Tipping players surveyedJune2015; May2015 losses. High-spender oversampling and7.5% response; one operator-linked cohort.
counting_note: One source-comparison programme; not representative of all gamblers/accounts/operators.

programme_label: Campos2023 six-session termination versus early depression-response classification
dataset_or_cohort_summary: 689 first admissions to California CalGETSJuly2015–April2017 with baseline PHQ-9>=10. Repeat admissions excluded by first-admission selection;594 complete regression cases from605 with>=2 visits.
counting_note: One direct indicator-classification/interpretability evaluation, not a general dropout validity scale. Also a representative application; no double primary-programme count. Included in Hawker2025 synthesis, not an additional independent dataset.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: 9410 Monzo customers with>=1 complete month;1030 had gambling deposits. Block users intentionally oversampled; one bank, variable duration. HSBC companion report not independently extracted.
counting_note: One related outflow specification/feasibility programme; no exact 90-day validation. Application counted separately, not again as subsequent primary.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: 424 UK Prolific participants with>=1 electronic gambling transaction; bank data matched to one-year PGSI. Audit and association models share this cohort; no dataset-independence claim.
counting_note: Count one limited primary data-quality programme for a related annual operationalisation; not a 90-day accuracy validation or diagnostic-validation programme. PGSI association use recorded as application.

programme_label: English IMD 2019 official construction and quality-assurance programme
dataset_or_cohort_summary: England 32844 Census 2011 LSOAs;39 source indicators. Multiple administrative/census/modelled input datasets and their timepoints; not a participant psychometric study.
counting_note: One index-construction programme including internal audit and external scrutiny. No separate independent subsequent count from checks within defining report.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: 24655 individuals in 13995 households across 10147EnglishLSOAs; Understanding Society wave 11 (source describes 2019). Table 1 individual-income validN24652; complete-case models. Official IMD 2019 data reused.
counting_note: One direct proxy-methodology evaluation, not proof of individual deprivation validity. Author-independent from 2019 defining team; official input reuse and possible survey overlap with other literature are not new dataset independence.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: Seven previously collected UK patient datasets; some baseline and follow-up observations combined. Table6 contains2298EQ5D and2192SF6D index observations, not unique participant counts.
counting_note: One primary methodological programme scoped to utility inputs. No QALY-level validity, gambling validation or author/dataset-independence claim.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: EVALUATE1346women; two related surgical comparisons, up to6weeks/4months/1year follow-up;182administratively censored. Simulation100subjects per arm,10000replicates per correlation scenario.
counting_note: Empirical reanalysis and simulation form one methodological programme; no independent-new-cohort or gambling-validation claim.

dataset_or_cohort_summary: Existing REFLUX RCT:178surgery and179medical-management participants; postalEQ5D3/12months then yearly to5years. Multiple analyses reuse the same trial.
counting_note: One empirical methodological reanalysis programme; not multiple programmes for each estimator or a new gambling cohort.

programme_label: MSC defining method and developer-led Target10 development case
dataset_or_cohort_summary: Shared MSC development tradition; guide synthesises multiple experiences, including development cases. Target10 is Australian dairy extension, not recovery.
counting_note: Two defining publications/resources; one grouped development programme for counting, not two independent validation studies. No inference of a single dataset across all guide examples.

programme_label: ADRA Laos MSC pilot external methodological evaluation
dataset_or_cohort_summary: Two projects within one2003–2004 pilot/external evaluation. Guide discusses related Laos experience; no claim of dataset independence from defining literature.
counting_note: Retained adjacent generic MSC methodology; excluded from exact recovery-narrative subsequent-primary count. Author-independent only.

programme_label: West Auckland community GMB methods/process evaluation
dataset_or_cohort_summary: Single community process;17 participants,14 attended all three workshops; associated substantive nutrition publication uses same study, not additionally retained.
counting_note: One primary methodological programme and one retained publication. Same paper also illustrates observed application; no additional programme count. No gambling-specific validation or author-independence claim.
